note: Recorded from src/music.s and src/rng.s at commit 549c9cf, before the C128 edition introduced any conditional assembly into them. The C128 build reuses these sources behind assembly-time defines rather than forking them, so the title theme and the PRNG cannot drift between editions. These hashes are the guard: any edit that changes what the canonical C64 build gets out of them fails make c128-parity.
